acquisition_unit: One archived generation response for one source document and one strategy, including all parsed candidates and rejected-candidate records. Never an entire strategy bank.
queues: For each episode, source-document packets ordered by SHA256(source_document_id); deletion and augmentation share the same ordered documents. No outcome sorting. Each acquire advances one packet, including failed/empty generation outcomes.
observation_denominators: Record features use max(1, initial record count). Active rules use the fixed cap 4*20. Packet fractions use 20; per-strategy acquisition uses 2. Masks only expose budget/queue exhaustion, current detections, and emptying protection; never hidden packet contents or labels.
repair: Remove all currently forbidden-only typed records as a deterministic batch. Allowed+forbidden conflicts abstain. Refuse deleting every remaining record. Permission arriving after deletion creates a logged late-permission event and does not restore the record automatically.

reward.graph_potential: 1 - current forbidden-only record count / max(1, initial record count)
reward.rule_potential: Distinct initial record IDs currently matched by at least one active non-conflicting rule / max(1, initial record count). Initial records are public input, not reference facts; retaining this universe avoids changing the denominator by deletion.
reward.step: 0.5 * delta graph_potential + 0.5 * delta rule_potential - 0.004 * acquired_response_count - 0.00002 * deleted_record_count - newly_introduced_forbidden_only_record_count / max(1, initial_record_count)
reward.new_identity: Difference of violation record-ID sets, including newly revealed violations after acquisition; not count subtraction. Log acquisition-revealed vs edit-created events separately.
reward.stop: Zero transition reward, then terminate. No terminal gold reward.
reward.interpretation: Observable constraint/coverage proxy, not semantic accuracy. Acquiring a useful new constraint may initially lower the reward; retain fixed stop and acquire-then-repair controls to detect this incentive failure. No coefficient adjustment on test outcomes.

training.epsilon: Linear 1.0 to 0.05 over 250 episodes; no checkpoint selection

baselines: repair when feasible else acquire deletion/augmentation alternately
split: Group by original source_document_id, shared across strategies, graphs, packets, and paraphrases. Hash seed 20260928, 60/20/20 train/dev/test. No corpus currently meets prerequisites; materialized membership and data/packet hashes must be sealed before any training. Freeze implementation after synthetic tests and before independent evaluation labels are opened.
statistics: Average evaluation documents within each training seed; 10 paired seed means, 10000 paired bootstrap, exact 1024 sign permutations. Primary DDQN comparisons: DQN and the three nontrivial fixed acquisition/repair schedules selected by protocol IDs; F1 and correct-fact preservation, Holm across 8 tests. All other results descriptive. Documents shared across seeds are not independent replicates.
entry_requirements: Traceable explicit entity types and frozen relation vocabulary
Generation packets linked to source documents, model, prompt and raw response
Both strategies have applicable independently checked rules on natural inputs
Independent semantic graph/edit labels and source-grouped splits
Report schedule outcome diversity without selecting only nonidentical episodes
All contract tests pass; real dataset and implementation manifests sealed
cost_reporting: Cached replay actual API calls are zero. Response acquisition count is a separate environment budget. Original generation attempts, retry counts, tokens and latency retain their provenance and are reported separately.
test_contracts: one acquisition equals one response even if empty or failed
same rule deduplicates but retains all origins
opposite kinds on same pattern abstain
late permission logs removed record identity
no acquisition past budget or queue end
repair masked when no flags or all records flagged
stop is always available before termination
labels absent from constructor and policy observations
introduced violation identities use set difference
same source document cannot cross splits
